revisions.title: Non-blocking generation
revisions.body: uuid7_gen() shall never block, sleep or wait for the wall clock; its only retry shall be the compare-and-swap of the reservation state.
revisions.rationale: Callers sit on request paths; a lock or a wait would couple them.
revisions.criteria: Analysis of uuid7_gen(): no lock, no sleep, no wait; the loop repeats only after a failed compare-and-swap (another thread reserved first, or the weak form failed spuriously), so some thread always progresses.

revisions.reason: SVS and SUITP: the test cases of tests/ (written by ecss/make.sh)
revisions.title: Abuse bound: generation refuses to run more than UUID7_MAX_AHEAD_MS ahead of the wall clock.
revisions.body: With the wall clock frozen, the generator may borrow logical milliseconds only up to UUID7_MAX_AHEAD_MS past it. Park the state exactly at the bound (sequence one short of exhaustion), prove the last in-bound id is minted, then prove the next reservation — which would need bound+1 — is refused with -3 and leaves the state untouched. Advancing the wall clock by one millisecond lifts the bound by one and the refused reservation succeeds.
revisions.criteria: Every assertion of test_gen_refuses_beyond_ahead_bound holds.
